ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface area, contrasted by a low-intensity (black/dark-grey) peripheral band and localized focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white central field across both lobes; low-intensity black contiguous band along the entire trailing edge; three distinct circular low-intensity blobs on the mid-left lobe; localized dark stippling at the base of the median notch; dark linear mark on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is roughly 10% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; maximum pixel-amplitude of peaks located on the distal third of both lobes; more pronounced and jagged on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edge (where visible) shows a shallow convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark-pixel clusters (3-4 distinct units) on the left ventral lobe; dense high-contrast white/grey clusters (barnacle colonization) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single, well-defined diagonal dark linear mark on the upper-mid section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on the distal tips creating a jagged, non-organic profile; multiple circular scars on the left lobe surface consistent with prior parasitic or physical attachment marks.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits an extremely irregular, 'shredded' topography, particularly on the outer segments of the left lobe.
